creative.problem: a talk-show intro must feel like match night and say the show's name
creative.evidence: the owner's host footage and the show name; no invented stats, clubs or claims
creative.light: floodlit night stadium: banks switch on, cones, crowd lights; gold title
creative.camera: push-out from a floodlight bank → top-down tactics → swoop to low 3D → ball follow → goal reaction → bullet-time orbit → whip to the big screen
creative.motion: chalk scribble, chalk marks pop, tube arcs lift, holographic players rise, ball passes/shot, net bulge, sparks + rays, rewind, frozen orbit with HUD, extruded title + light sweep
creative.sound: floodlight clunks, chalk, ball thumps, net + crowd roar, tape rewind, HUD ticks, title bells
creative.payoff: the show name, gold and white, extruded, underlined by the line, the ball as its full stop

shots.purpose: six floodlight banks switch on; a chalk line scribbles; the show name slams; the line sweeps it away
top-down chalk board: O and X pop, arrows draw; on the drop the arrows lift into 3D arcs and players rise
three passes along the arcs, dribble, shot, goal: net bulge, flash, sparks, rays
the ball rewinds into mid-flight and freezes; the camera orbits; HUD rings and the dotted remaining trajectory draw
the camera whips to the big screen showing the owner's footage of the host
the show name on the big screen: blur-resolve, extrusion grows, light sweep, underline, the ball as a dot; hold
